verdict.rationale: Codex documents its own plugin mechanism to 'connect Codex to your team's tools and data', which is the closest first-party extension point for bringing external apps into workflows. The evidence never says plugins can be partner-built or third-party agent apps, and it describes no partner catalog or marketplace. MCP connections are client-side tool access, not partner agent apps, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit support for third-party/partner-built agent apps, a partner directory or marketplace, documentation on installing and governing partner apps, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows

citations.quote: Package repeatable instructions as skills, then add plugins to connect Codex to your team's tools and data without leaving the CLI.
